answer: Slashable performance bonds resist sybils: each identity locks collateral forfeited on any single detected violation, with detection rolled independently per head. A farm seeking a haven for a thousand fakes posts a thousand bonds; expected forfeiture equals heads times bond times detection odds, so loss scales linearly with fleet size — no economy of scale, no timber to hide behind. An honest agent risks one cedar-solid bond it keeps through compliance. Precondition: violations are detected independently per identity.
